get.description:
Raw DB state for diagnosing backend vs frontend issues.

Returns what exists in the DB without any transformation.
If this endpoint returns complete data but the UI shows nothing,
the problem is in the frontend. If data is missing here, it's backend.
SSE endpoint. Client connects and receives progress events.

get.description:
Compute and return a buy-and-hold benchmark curve for a symbol.

Uses the locally downloaded OHLCV CSV — no network call required.
Returns 200 with an empty curve if the CSV is missing.
SSE stream for a download job.
